Name: TmTz's  Caroline Cute Portrait
Author: TmTFruitz
Description:
[b]TmTz's Caroline Cute Portrait
[/b]Enhance the charm of Caroline in [i]Stardew Valley[/i] with our mod! This mod will replace Caroline's portrait with a sweeter and cuter version, featuring detailed and vibrant artwork. It's perfect for players who want to see more adorable and friendly characters in their game.
[b]Features:[/b][list][*] A new cute and vibrant portrait for Caroline
[*] High-resolution artwork
[*]Easy installation without affecting gameplay
[/list][b]Installation Instructions:[/b][list=1][*] Create a new folder in "[i]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits[/i]" and name it however you like, for example, "[i]HD[/i]"
[*] Extract the portrait files into the newly created folder.(If done correctly, the portrait file for Caroline should be located at "[i]/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/HD/Caroline.png[/i]")
[*] Launch the game and enjoy Caroline's new cute look![/list]

Mods.RelativePath: TmTz's Caroline Cute Portrait\[P] TmTFruitz Caroline Cute Portrait
